lr3.createsIn.en: This creates {campaigns} on {provider} in the {account} ad account.
lr3.createsIn.zh: 将在“{account}”的 {provider} 广告账户中创建 {campaigns}。

lr3.createsAcross.zh: 将在 {provider} 的 {accounts} 中创建 {campaigns}。

lr3.startsPausedOne.en: It starts paused and spends nothing until someone turns it on.
lr3.startsPausedOne.zh: 它以暂停状态创建，在有人开启前不会产生花费。

lr3.startsPausedMany.en: They start paused and spend nothing until someone turns them on.
lr3.startsPausedMany.zh: 它们以暂停状态创建，在有人开启前不会产生花费。

lr3.startsLiveOne.en: It is created enabled and can begin spending once {provider} approves it.
lr3.startsLiveOne.zh: 它以启用状态创建，通过 {provider} 审核后即可开始花费。

lr3.startsLiveMany.en: They are created enabled and can begin spending once {provider} approves them.
lr3.startsLiveMany.zh: 它们以启用状态创建，通过 {provider} 审核后即可开始花费。

lr3.mediaOnly.en: The platform receives only the media budget.

lr3.checkFirst.zh: 投放前请先确认以下事项

lr3.noteHelp.en: Who authorized this launch on the producer's behalf.
lr3.noteHelp.zh: 谁授权了这次代制片方的投放。
